records.key: Gemini requires Node.js. On macOS and Linux, the command below installs Node.js and Gemini CLI in your user account. On Windows, install Node.js before running the npm command.
records.source: Gemini requires Node.js. On macOS and Linux, the command below installs Node.js and Gemini CLI in your user account. On Windows, install Node.js before running the npm command.
records.translation: O Gemini requer Node.js. No macOS e no Linux, o comando abaixo instala Node.js e Gemini CLI na sua conta de usuário. No Windows, instale Node.js antes de executar o comando npm.

records.translation: O status do login não está disponível; use a CLI para confirmar sua conta.
